_what: The variation library — every variation instruction a designer runs from a BASELINE draft, as a named delta. Stage 4e of image teardown writes its variation list against these ids so the brief and the library say the same words. Each row is one delta off the baseline; the baseline rides along as the reference; every result is judged against the baseline by the two-picture judge.
_curator: Damon. Status per row. A changed row is a NEW file -v<N+1>-damon.json beside this one.

variations.name: Headline swap
variations.what: the same picture with a different headline — the words change, nothing else
variations.delta: re-letter the headline so it reads "{headline}" — same typeface, same size, same colour, same position
checks: The headline reads exactly "{headline}". Nothing else in the picture changed.

variations.name: Angle swap
variations.what: the same layout carrying a different argument — the headline and the proof line change to the new angle's words, the picture stays
variations.delta: re-letter the headline to "{headline}" and the proof line to "{proof}" — same type, same positions
keep: the picture, the people, the product and the layout
checks: The headline reads "{headline}" and the proof line reads "{proof}". The picture under the type is unchanged.

variations.name: Person swap
variations.what: the same ad on a different person from the brand's cast — face, hair and build change; pose, framing, wardrobe register and everything else hold
variations.delta: replace the person with a different {who} — a new face, hair and build — in the same pose, framing and wardrobe register
keep: the product and where it is held
checks: The person is visibly a different individual — face, hair, build — in the same pose and framing. Product, type and background are unchanged.

variations.name: Product swap
variations.what: the same ad selling a different product from the brand — the product and its name in the type change, nothing else
variations.delta: replace the product with the attached product photo at the same angle and size, and re-letter its name in the type to "{product_name}"
keep: the person, the pose, the layout, the background
checks: The product matches the attached photo and its name in the type reads "{product_name}". Person, pose, layout and background are unchanged.

variations.name: Colour swap
variations.what: the same ad in a different accent colour from the brand's palette — every accent surface changes to the named colour, nothing else
variations.delta: change every accent surface from {from_colour} to {to_colour}
keep: the layout, the type, the people, the product
checks: Every surface that was {from_colour} is now {to_colour}. Nothing else changed.

variations.name: Background swap
variations.what: the same foreground on a different setting
variations.delta: replace the background with {background}, keeping every foreground element exactly where it is
keep: the subject, the product and the type, to the pixel
checks: The background is now {background}. Subject, product and type are unchanged.

variations.name: Reframe to another placement
variations.what: the same ad re-composed for a different frame — 9:16 to 4:5, 4:5 to 1:1 — the elements move only as far as the new frame forces, the safe zone is respected
variations.delta: recompose for a {aspect} frame: keep every element, move each only as far as the new frame forces, nothing inside the safe zone
keep: every element and its relative order
checks: Every element from the reference is present, in the same relative order, sized the same. Nothing is cropped or cut off.
